posts.author: Stereofan
posts.content_md:
I can't remember where I saw this, but I seem to remember some lapidary journal carrying an article on a professional lapidarist who faceted gems in such a way as to produce holograms inside the stone.

Along similar lines, I was wondering if fringe patterns could be faceted into stones. Probably not.
